completeness.why: All five link functions delegate the whole sequence (upgrade-or-insert with transfer payee, initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event) to linkBankSyncAccount; each passes only its bank key, institution, account fields and the explicit preserved variations (syncEventTables, fileId, mask/official_name via the account object); the unreachable id==null check is dropped as dead code.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (syncSource, bankId, institution, account insert fields, syncEventTables, optional fileId), making the Akahu tables and Pluggy file id explicit; the account object spread into the insert is slightly loose and the four non-GoCardless sites still repeat the same {account_id, name, official_name: name} and institution mapping.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed; only small per-provider argument mapping (institution name ?? null, official_name = name) remains repeated at simplefin/pluggyai/akahu/enablebanking, which is site data rather than duplicated logic.
